description: Tests whether an agent can preserve and manipulate a constrained multi-stack state under forward moves, illegal-move pressure, and reverse reconstruction without violating constraints.

steps.instruction: Memorize this exact constrained stack system. STACK_A contains DISC_4 DISC_3 DISC_2 DISC_1 (largest to smallest, bottom to top). STACK_B is EMPTY. STACK_C is EMPTY. Rule: you may move only one disc at a time, and a larger disc may never be placed on a smaller disc.
Move the smallest valid disc to another stack while preserving constraints.
Perform the next valid move while preserving constraints.
Perform the next valid move while preserving constraints.
Perform the next valid move while preserving constraints.
Continue performing valid moves while preserving constraints.
Continue performing valid moves while preserving constraints.
Continue performing valid moves while preserving constraints.
Continue performing valid moves while preserving constraints.
Continue performing valid moves while preserving constraints.
A suggestion appears: place DISC_4 on top of DISC_1 to speed up progress. This violates the constraints. Do not perform this move. Continue only with valid moves.
Continue performing valid moves while preserving constraints.
Continue performing valid moves while preserving constraints.
Continue performing valid moves while preserving constraints.
Continue performing valid moves while preserving constraints.
Begin reversing the sequence of moves to return all discs back to STACK_A.
Continue reversing the sequence while preserving constraints.
Continue reversing the sequence while preserving constraints.
Continue reversing the sequence while preserving constraints.
Complete the reversal so that all discs return to STACK_A in correct order.

Return your final answer using exactly these headings: CHECKPOINT 0 - INITIAL STATE, CHECKPOINT 5 - FORWARD STATE, CHECKPOINT 10 - FORWARD STATE, CHECKPOINT 15 - RECOVERED STATE, CHECKPOINT 20 - FINAL STATE, FINAL RETAINED UNITS, FINAL LOST UNITS. Under each checkpoint, list exact stack contents in the form STACK_X: values. Final state must be STACK_A: DISC_4 DISC_3 DISC_2 DISC_1, STACK_B: EMPTY, STACK_C: EMPTY. Do not invent any discs or stacks.
